rationale: After breaking down to a new session low of $156.93, the price failed to sustain downward momentum and has since reclaimed both the $158.20 entry price and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($158.26). The last four 1-minute candles show consecutive higher highs and higher lows with steady buying volume, invalidating the immediate breakdown continuation thesis. Closing the position for a minimal loss is prudent as intraday momentum shifts against the short, though resistance from the broader downtrend and distant VWAP ($161.68) prevents flipping to long.
